description: This file defines a cost calculator function `cost_calculator` for RunwayML image generation within the litellm framework. It imports necessary modules, retrieves model info, and calculates the cost based on the number of images in an ImageResponse object.

classes.name: ImageResponse
classes.description: A class imported from litellm.types.utils representing the image response data structure.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( model: str, image_response: Any, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost of image generation for RunwayML based on the number of images and the per-image pricing stored in model info.
